name: mc-smoke
description: Monte Carlo harness acceptance test: diode-connected nfet_01v8 mismatch. Not a SAR ADC circuit.
claim: None -- harness self-verification, not a spec claim. Proves the Monte Carlo plumbing (rndseed reproducibility, the tt_mm local-mismatch switch, and the deterministic negative control) actually takes effect on a real sky130 device, so later ENOB/INL/DNL/offset distribution records against ratified spec lines (#1) can be trusted.

notes: Harness acceptance testbench (issue #2). The negative control (N draws at the plain 'tt' corner, mismatch disabled, same seed sequence as the 'real' tt_mm draws) must reproduce vgs_nfet EXACTLY (stdev == 0) -- see sim/harness/mc_runner.py's negative_control_ok() docstring for why a nonzero negative-control stdev invalidates the accompanying distribution.
